courses.title: Data Analytics for Nonprofit Teams
courses.description: Data Analytics for Nonprofit Teams focuses on data analytics for people working toward a Data Analyst role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces spreadsheet modelling, enough to apply alongside data analytics in real Data Analyst work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to data analytics and show how spreadsheet modelling supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying data analytics to a real Data Analyst scenario
Practicing data analytics through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to spreadsheet modelling
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Database Querying in Practice
courses.description: Database Querying in Practice goes beyond the basics of database querying, for people already working toward a Data Analyst role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in database querying and want to go further.

courses.title: Survey Data Collection Fundamentals
courses.description: Survey Data Collection Fundamentals is a short introduction to survey data collection for people moving toward a Data Analyst role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show survey data collection in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if survey data collection is new to you.
